title: Corporate Strategy
completion_message: ¡Magistral! La estrategia corporativa no se trata de trabajar más duro, sino de jugar de manera más inteligente. Con este vocabulario, tienes la visión de un CEO moderno.

parts.visual:
Los CEOs usan lenguaje de estrategia y teoría de juegos. 

1. Zero-sum game (Juego de suma cero): 
- Una situación donde si uno gana, el otro pierde exactamente la misma cantidad. No hay ganancia mutua. 
Ej: In this saturated market, stealing clients is a ZERO-SUM GAME. 

2. First-mover advantage (Ventaja del pionero): 
- La ventaja competitiva que gana la primera empresa en entrar a un mercado nuevo. 
Ej: Amazon had a massive FIRST-MOVER ADVANTAGE in e-commerce. 

3. Paradigm shift (Cambio de paradigma): 
- Un cambio fundamental en cómo se hace algo, a menudo causado por nueva tecnología. 
Ej: The smartphone caused a PARADIGM SHIFT in personal computing.
parts.audio: Welcome to Corporate Strategy. Modern CEOs use the language of strategy and game theory. Number 1: Zero-sum game. A situation where one person's gain is exactly equal to another person's loss. There is no mutual benefit. For example: In this saturated market, stealing clients is a ZERO-SUM GAME. Number 2: First-mover advantage. The competitive advantage gained by the initial significant occupant of a market segment. For example: Amazon had a massive FIRST-MOVER ADVANTAGE in e-commerce. Number 3: Paradigm shift. A fundamental change in approach or underlying assumptions, usually driven by new technology. For example: The smartphone caused a PARADIGM SHIFT in personal computing.

parts.visual:
4. Core competency (Competencia central/principal): 
- La fortaleza única y principal de una empresa. 
Ej: We should outsource accounting and focus on our CORE COMPETENCY: software design. 

5. Economies of scale (Economías de escala): 
- Cuando produces más, el costo por unidad disminuye. 
Ej: Walmart can offer lower prices because of its massive ECONOMIES OF SCALE. 

6. Exit strategy (Estrategia de salida): 
- El plan de un inversor o fundador para vender su parte y retirar su dinero. 
Ej: The investors want to know your EXIT STRATEGY before they give you millions. 

7. Synergy (Sinergia): 
- Cuando 1 + 1 = 3. La combinación de empresas vale más que sus partes individuales. 
Ej: The merger will create massive SYNERGIES.
parts.audio: Number 4: Core competency. A defining capability or advantage that distinguishes an enterprise from its competitors. For example: We should outsource accounting and focus on our CORE COMPETENCY: software design. Number 5: Economies of scale. Cost advantages reaped by companies when production becomes efficient. Producing more makes each unit cheaper. For example: Walmart can offer lower prices because of its massive ECONOMIES OF SCALE. Number 6: Exit strategy. An entrepreneur or investor's strategic plan to sell their ownership in a company. For example: The investors want to know your EXIT STRATEGY before they give you millions. Finally, Number 7: Synergy. The concept that the combined value and performance of two companies will be greater than the sum of the separate individual parts.

questions.question: In this market, you can't create new customers. To grow, you must steal them from rivals. It is a ____-sum game. (Suma cero).
questions.explanation: Zero-sum game = juego de suma cero (lo que gano yo, lo pierdes tú).

questions.question: By being the very first to launch an electric truck, they gained a huge ____-mover advantage.
questions.explanation: First-mover advantage = ventaja de ser el primero.

questions.question: The invention of artificial intelligence is causing a massive ____ shift in how humans work. (Cambio de paradigma).
questions.explanation: Paradigm shift = cambio fundamental o de paradigma.

questions.question: We are trying to do too many things. We need to stop selling hardware and return to our ____ competency: software. (Competencia principal).
questions.explanation: Core competency = tu fortaleza o habilidad principal.

questions.question: Because China produces millions of phones a day, they have incredible economies of ____, making each phone very cheap.
questions.explanation: Economies of scale = economías de escala.

questions.question: The venture capitalists will give you $10 million, but they want to know how they will get their money back. What is your ____ strategy?
questions.explanation: Exit strategy = estrategia de salida (vender la empresa a un gigante o salir a bolsa).

questions.question: Combining our marketing team with their sales team will create powerful ____. Together we are stronger. (Sinergias).
questions.explanation: Synergies = sinergias (el conjunto es mayor que la suma de las partes).

questions.question: Moving quickly to copy a competitor's successful innovation is the strategy of a 'fast ____'. (Seguidor rápido).
questions.explanation: Fast follower = una empresa que no innova primero, sino que copia rápido y mejor (como Microsoft muchas veces).

questions.question: When a company expands by acquiring its suppliers or distributors, it is called ____ integration. (Integración vertical).
questions.explanation: Vertical integration = poseer toda la cadena de suministro.

questions.question: When a company expands by acquiring its direct competitors in the same industry, it is called ____ integration.
questions.explanation: Horizontal integration = comprar a tus competidores.

questions.question: A business model where you give away the basic product for free, but charge for premium features, is called ____. (Freemium).
To completely change a company's business model or direction because the current one is failing is to ____. (Pivotar).
If we launch a new product that is too similar to our existing ones, it will steal our own sales. This is called ____. (Canibalización).
questions.explanation: Cannibalization = cuando un producto nuevo se 'come' las ventas de tu producto viejo.

questions.question: A situation in a market where there are only a few dominant sellers (like airlines or telecom) is an ____. (Oligopolio).
questions.explanation: Oligopoly = mercado dominado por muy pocas empresas gigantes.

questions.question: A unique feature that makes a product stand out from all competitors is its USP (Unique ____ Proposition).
questions.explanation: Unique Selling Proposition (USP) = propuesta única de venta.

questions.question: The 'barrier to ____' refers to the high costs or obstacles that prevent new competitors from easily entering an industry. (Barrera de entrada).
questions.explanation: Barrier to entry = barreras de entrada al mercado.

questions.question: To use something to your maximum advantage is to ____ it. (Apalancar / Sacar provecho).
questions.explanation: Leverage = apalancar o aprovechar al máximo (en finanzas, significa endeudarse para invertir, pero en management significa sacar provecho).

questions.question: A highly profitable product or division that generates steady income to fund the rest of the company is a cash ____. (Vaca lechera).
questions.explanation: Cash cow = el producto que siempre da dinero seguro y estable.

questions.question: We need to think outside the ____ to solve this complex problem. (Pensar fuera de lo convencional).
A business strategy trying to find a new, uncontested market space with no competition is called a Blue ____ strategy. (Océano azul).
questions.explanation: Blue Ocean strategy = estrategia del océano azul (buscar mercados donde no hay competidores todavía).

questions.question: A ____-sum game. (Suma cero con Z)
____-mover advantage. (Ventaja del primero con F)
A ____ shift. (Cambio de paradigma con P)
Our ____ competency. (Competencia principal con C)
Economies of ____. (Economías de escala con S)
What's the ____ strategy? (Estrategia de salida/venta con E)
We will create ____. (Sinergias con S)
Product ____. (Canibalización de tu propio producto con C)
A high barrier to ____. (Barrera de entrada al mercado con E)
We must ____ our assets. (Aprovechar/apalancar con L)
